violations.title: Non-TCS Food Contact Surface, Clean per Manufacturer
violations.observation: Surfaces of ice bins, beverage dispensing nozzles, and enclosed components of equipment are not being cleaned as required. OBSERVED RESIDUE BUILD-UP ON THE INTERIOR OF THE ICE MACHINE.
violations.corrective_action: Surfaces of utensils and equipment contacting food that is NOT time/temperature control for safety food such as ice bins, beverage dispensing nozzles, and enclosed components of equipment such as ice makers, cooking oil storage tanks and distribution lines, beverage and syrup dispensing lines or tubes, coffee bean grinders, and water vending equipment at a frequency specified by the manufacturer or at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil or mold. PLEASE DRAIN THE ICE MACHINE, AND WASH, RINSE, AND SANITIZE THE INTERIOR. CORRECT THIS BY JULY 23RD. INCREASE THE CLEANING FREQUENCY MOVING FORWARD.

out_items.name: Proper reheating procedures for hot holding

violations.title: Reheating for Hot Holding, Temp Reached within 2 Hours
violations.observation: The following food item(s) was not reheated for hot holding within a sufficient time of 2 hours or less: OBSERVED CHILI IN BAINE MARIE AT 143F AFTER 2HRS OF STARTING THE REHEATING PROCESS.
violations.corrective_action: Reheating food for hot holding shall be done rapidly, within 2 hours to prevent growth of pathogens. CDI: CHILI DISPOSED OF. PIC RE-EDUCATED ON PROPER REHEATING PROCEDURES. Wendy's #6534 (Inspection Date: 07/13/2026) Page 2 of 4

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED IN ONE-DOOR UNDER COUNTER (5): LIGHT CREAM AT 46-47F (1HR).
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CDI: MOVED TO WALK-IN COOLER.

violations.title: Eggs Stored at 45F or less
violations.observation: Observed an ambient air temperature above 45F in the following refrigeration unit holding raw shells eggs: OBSERVED IN ONE-DOOR PREP-TOP (ACROSS FROM GRILL) (3): RAW SHELL EGGS IN AN AMBIENT AIR TEMPERATURE OF 63F (30MIN).
violations.corrective_action: Shell eggs that have not been treated to destroy Salmonella shall be stored in refrigerated equipment that maintains an ambient temperature of 45F or less. CDI: RAW SHELL EGGS MOVED TO WALK-IN COOLER.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Insect Control Devices, Installation
violations.observation: OBSERVED INSECT CONTROL DEVICE STORED OVER A COUNTER WHICH WAS USED TO STORE MAPLE SYRUP PACKETS AND COFFEE SYRUPS.
violations.corrective_action: Relocate the insect control device so that it is not located over a food preparation area and dead insects are prevented from being falling on exposed food, clean equipment, utensils, linens, and unwrapped single-service and single-use articles. CDI: FOOD ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE COUNTER.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage Clean and Dry Location
violations.observation: Food stored in a wet or soiled location as follows: OBSERVED BAGS OF PICKLES, MAYO, KETCHUP, AND STRAWBERRY PURÉE SETTING IN POOLED WATER ON A CART AND NEAR THE DISHWASHING MACHINE.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food in a clean, dry location. CDI: BAGS OF FOOD MOVED TO INDIVIDUAL CONTAINERS. PIC RE-EDUCATED.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: OBSERVED ONE-DOOR PREP-TOP AT 63F AT TIME OF INSPECTION. OBSERVED WATER FILTER/CONDENSER FOR POP MACHINE LEAKING INTO A FIVE GALLON BUCKET.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. TCS FOOD REMOVED FROM THE COOLER. PIC UNDERSTANDS THIS UNIT MAY NOT USED TO STORE TCS FOODS (INCLUDING RAW SHELL EGGS) UNTIL IT IS REPAIRED TO HOLD FOOD AT 41F OR BELOW OR 45F OR BELOW FOR RAW SHELL EGGS. PIC CALLED FOR MAINTENANCE BEFORE TIME OF INSPECTION. THE WATER FILTER/CONDENSER MUST BE REPAIRED OR ADJUSTED TO NOT LEAK BY JULY 23RD.

out_items.name: Adequate ventilation and lighting, designated areas used

violations.title: Mechanical Ventilation System Capacity
violations.observation: Ventilation is not sufficient to keep rooms free of excessive obnoxious odors. OBSERVED NOXIOUS ODORS AND FUMES AT THE COOKLINE.
violations.corrective_action: Provide mechanical ventilation at a sufficient capacity to minimize soiling of walls, ceilings, and equipment; efficiently remove obnoxious odors and toxic fumes; and prevent the creation of hazards or nuisances involving the accumulation of fats, oils, and fumes. VENTILATION MUST BE REPAIRED TO ENSURE NOXIOUS ODORS ARE NOT PRESENT IN THE COOKING AREA. THIS MUST BE CORRECTED BY JULY 23, 2026.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Design Features
violations.observation: The backflow or backsiphonage prevention device installed on the mop sink spigot is not identified as meeting standards set by the American Society of Sanitary Engineering.
violations.corrective_action: A backflow or back siphonage prevention device installed on a water supply system shall meet American Society of Sanitary Engineering (A.S.S.E.) standards for construction, installation, maintenance, inspection, and testing for that specific application and type of device. PIC took off the unapproved splitter for the mop sink, called ECOLAB to attach approved splitter

out_items.name: Adequate ventilation and lighting, designated areas used

violations.title: Ventilation Hood, Adequate
violations.observation: Observed smoke from fryers not being adequately removed by hood system. Smoke observed to be wafting throughout kitchen area.
violations.corrective_action: CFM stated he has opened a work order for hood system. System is not operating at full-capacity. EHS will follow up with CFM to ensure hood system is repaired in a timely manner.
